purpose: Independent published-data sanity check only, not a strategy selection or profitability experiment.

period.role: Gap between study training and the 2017+ retrospective test; no 2017+ or 2024+ strategy metrics inspected.

primary_input.normalization: No dividends credited; raw quote price-only, never adjclose

comparison_dataset.quote_vendor_origin: Not established from the retrieved README/metadata; official repository publisher is verified, independent upstream vendor lineage is not.

normalization.lean_prices: Equity OHLC integer values divided by 10000, confirmed from the actual official TradeBar.cs parser.
normalization.lean_volume: Unscaled numeric field; publisher aggregation differences retained.
normalization.session_date: Yahoo UTC session-opening timestamp converted to America/New_York calendar date; Lean first-column YYYYMMDD used as session date.
normalization.split_factors: All 16 SPY factor rows dated in the comparison gap have split factor 1. Yahoo reports no split events. Therefore raw and split-adjusted SPY units coincide in this gap.
normalization.dividend_adjustments: Not applied on either side. Lean price factors are not multiplied into prices; Yahoo adjclose is not used. This checks price-only OHLC and does not validate total-return or dividend cash-flow handling.

volume.note: Volume aggregation/venue coverage can differ; no volume acceptance assertion.

finding: All 1008 session dates agree and price units are consistent. Closing-price differences are small on average but prices are not identical; some intraday OHLC discrepancies are material for stop execution. This is partial source sanity evidence, not certification of every bar or executable broker prices.
coverage_limits: Only SPY and the 2013–2016 gap were compared. The other ETFs and the 2017–2023 / 2024–2026 study prices were not cross-validated by this check.
Original upstream vendor identity and source independence are not established merely by two publication endpoints.
The repository Apache-2.0 LICENSE and data-format README were read. No separate price-data redistribution grant was found; raw ZIP, factor file and Yahoo rows remain local scratch/input only.
Volume differs on all matching dates; venue/session aggregation and cleaning differences are not resolved here.
No source switching, strategy change, parameter optimization or retrospective winner substitution is authorized by this comparison.
acceptance_gate: Descriptive comparison only; no binary market-data accuracy or profitability pass is asserted.
